resources.string: Features
This is a benchmark launch. These switches show the launch options and cannot be changed.
Voice calls
Call someone without video, and add video during the call. A voice call plays from the earpiece. Someone on an older version of the app answers with their camera on.
Play ringing tone
Hear a ringing tone while the other phone rings.
Pause camera at ear
In a video call with sound on the earpiece, stop sending your camera while the phone is held to your ear.
Show calls on lock screen
An incoming call turns the screen on and appears over the lock screen. The caller\'s name stays hidden until you unlock, unless you allow it below.
Android needs your permission to show call alerts over the lock screen.
Open Android settings
Allow full-screen incoming calls: Android shows calls from MeshLive only as a notification while your phone is locked or you are in another app.
Allow
%1$s called while you were calling %2$s. They were told you are busy; your call goes on.
%1$s called while you were dialling. They were told you are busy.
Call buttons in notifications
Incoming and ongoing calls show Answer, Decline and Hang up buttons in the notification.
Show names on lock screen
Off: a locked phone shows only “Incoming call”. Anyone who can see your screen can read a name shown here.
Chats (beta)
Send messages, voice notes and photos to a contact. They\'re delivered when your phones are near each other.
Send chats automatically
When a contact comes into range, send and receive waiting messages without a tap. Needs Chats.
Names and stream titles
Add an optional name to your ID and a title to your livestream. A stream title can be seen by anyone nearby before they join.
